testimonials.label: In their words
testimonials.quote1: "Saskia and Bella played a key role in building the brand’s social presence from the ground up. Their strategy and creative direction helped scale the channels quickly, generating millions of views, strong engagement, and a clear, premium identity. We have seen ebbs and flows of incredible growth: as they adapt to what's going on with the social landscape and monthly algorithmic changes. Any brand would be lucky to have them leading their social."
